Introduction

Choi Jun Seong, also known as Jun S, is South Korean singer under Maroo Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group GHOST9. He made his solo Japanese debut on June 9, 2025 with the digital single "Melty Love".

He is also known for being a contestant on the survival show Produce X 101.
